svg.title: Response Preferences — a focused reply
svg.desc: A fictional chat with one question, a direct answer, useful underlines and a closing reminder. Other examples on the website introduce the wider range as you scroll.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: What does this skill actually do to your replies?
In response to: How Response Preferences changes the way replies look.
Response Preferences makes replies easier to skim.
The important points are underlined, and emojis help you spot answers,
results and anything that needs you.
You can read just the underlined parts for the main points,
or read the full reply for more detail.
About: the response style. Underlines and markers make replies easier to skim.
Coverage since last final reply: 1 user message; 1/1 requests and steers addressed.
